decisions.reason: The rye country bread rests directly on the firm's core baking know-how and established rye recipes, so the firm can readily read customer response and refine it at low cost.
The premium raisin stollen is a flagship product and repeatedly won the German Bread Institute's gold medal, so the firm clearly understands and masters this product.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a close variant of the existing bread range and fits the firm's knowledge and production processes, so keeping it carries little risk.
The dark barley malt rye bread draws on the firm's established rye expertise and has its own page, but with no reported results it remains somewhat more open to range trimming.
The marzipan stollen sits beside the award-winning stollen line and benefits from the same confectionery know-how and seasonal gift demand.
The ancient grain bread is presented as the newest masterpiece and builds on the firm's grain and baking expertise, so management will give it time to establish itself.
